channel.title: Mix That Drink - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Mix That Drink (mixthatdrink.com)

item.title: Candy Cane Martini
item.description: The Candy Cane Martini blends vodka with creme de menthe and Chambord. It's mostly peppermint, but with a strong hint of delicious raspberry.

item.title: Gingerbread Martini
item.description: Indulge in a Gingerbread Martini with gingerbread vodka, milk, chocolate syrup, nutmeg, and cinnamon. A festive, creamy cocktail for holiday celebrations.

item.title: Kahlua Bomb Cocktail
item.description: Sweet Kahlua meets cool peppermint schnapps and milk for a smooth cocktail that finishes clean and refreshingly minty.

item.title: Snowball Cocktail
item.description: Enjoy a festive Snowball Cocktail with Advocaat, brandy, fizzy lemonade, and a squeeze of lime. Perfect for cozy gatherings or holiday celebrations!

item.title: Red Rudolph Cocktail Recipe
item.description: Make the festive Red Rudolph cocktail, a warm blend of vodka, cranberry juice, orange curaçao, and cinnamon schnapps, topped with whipped cream and sugar pearls.

item.title: Raspberry Beret Drink Recipe
item.description: The Raspberry Beret is a catchy little cocktail named after a catchy little song. It's sweet and creamy and delicious - perfect as a dessert substitute.

item.title: Eggnog Recipe with Bourbon and Rum
item.description: Eggnog has been around for a very long time, in both its alcoholic and non-alcoholic forms. The eggnog recipe is most associated with Christmas, but has traditionally been served throughout the season from Halloween to New Years.

item.title: Grinch cocktail
item.description: Tired of Christmas drinks with cute names and more peppermint schnapps than you can drink in a month? Then the Grinch cocktail is the one for you. This drink features Midori, lemon juice, and simple syrup. That gives it a tart melon flavor that's sweet enough to go down easy.

item.title: Red Hot Santa Tini cocktail
item.description: Try the spicy-sweet flavor of the Red Hot Santa Tini, featuring chili-infused vodka, chocolate liqueur, and cream for a festive cocktail experience.

item.title: Holiday Cheer Cocktail
item.description: Enjoy the festive Holiday Cheer cocktail made with peppermint vodka, white crème de cacao, cranberry juice, rosemary syrup, and lime juice. Cheers!
